question: Use forward selection with AIC as the selection criterion to build a logistic regression model (max_iter=1000, random_state=42) predicting tumor vs. normal status from gene expression data. Start with no features and add one feature at a time, stopping when AIC no longer decreases.

expected_output.guidelines: The first 10 features must appear in the same order as the reference; the full selected feature set must match the reference exactly; header labels may differ.
The FINAL_AIC value must match the reference within +/-2; header labels may differ.
